description.en: The ID of the attached resource.

description.zh:
策略支持挂载点类型。

- HttpApi：HttpApi。
- Operation：HttpApi的Operation。
- GatewayRoute：网关路由。
- GatewayService：网关服务。
- GatewayServicePort：网关服务端口。
- Domain：网关域名。
- Gateway：网关。
description.en:
The type of the resource to which the policy can be attached. Valid values:
- HttpApi: HttpApi.
- Operation: an operation of an HttpApi.
- GatewayRoute: a gateway route.
- GatewayService: a gateway service.
- GatewayServicePort: a gateway service port.
- Domain: a gateway domain name.
- Gateway: a gateway.

description.zh:
策略出入站方向。
- 出站：OutBound。
- 入栈：InBound。
- 双方向：Both。
description.en:
The direction of the policy. Valid values:
- OutBound: outbound.
- InBound: inbound.
- Both: both directions.
The number of entries per page.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun apig list-policy-classes --type FlowControl --direction InBound --attach-resource-type Operation --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --attach-resource-id route-001 --gateway-id gw-001 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun apig GET /v1/policy-classes --region cn-hangzhou --attachResourceType Operation --attachResourceId 'route-001' --pageNumber 1 --pageSize 10 --type FlowControl --gatewayId 'gw-001' --direction InBound --header "Content-Type=application/json"
